method: Read-only source search and inspection; no runtime/customer/database/production configuration access. No external GTM account queried.

instrumentation.finding: Traffic reader counts search, view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout and purchase from Josh analytics_events, plus sessions/device/user IDs; analytics_funnel_daily and user_search_history are separate aggregate readers. These are not verified accepted orders.
Reader documents ninety-day raw retention and older funnel-only coverage. No-event/never-ordered claims cannot use this truncated raw source. Actual live retention and completeness remain unverified.

Repository searches of apps/libs found no GTM container installation, gtag/dataLayer producer or implementation of the three new event names. This does not prove absence on the separate Josh storefront or in production.
instrumentation.status: GTM container/tag/consent configuration inaccessible and unverified

instrumentation.finding: Potential SPA duplicate risk if future GTM History Change tags and application events both fire. No measured duplicate incident is claimed; audit actual trigger/tag configuration before any collector integration.

acceptedOrderAuthority.verifiedInternalCandidate: OrderCheckoutSaga conditionally moves pending_payment to confirmed and publishes order.confirmed in the same transaction. Checkout itself can return pending_payment or fail; it is not acceptance. The v1 proposed order_accepted basis is committed internal confirmation only.
acceptedOrderAuthority.identityGap: Storefront DTO has customerId and lines but no branch/company identity; order.confirmed payload is only id. Do not fabricate branch mapping or equate this with all Josh credit/assisted-order acceptance semantics.
acceptedOrderAuthority.outboxGap: DomainEvent declares eventId and occurredAt, but EventEmitterBus persists type/aggregateId/payload/metadata without those fields. Relay emits eventId=row.id and occurredAt=row.createdAt (outbox insert time). Those are stable delivery identifiers/times, not automatically the original domain occurrence fields; an adapter must define and verify its mapping.
acceptedOrderAuthority.joshSource: order.snapshot is latest-state replication with aggregate/version guards; it is not an immutable order-accepted event history. Josh copied user/company/branch/order IDs are nullable and create_date/copied_at have different meanings.

identity.finding: Customer AuthMe declares customer id, company id, branches and active_branch_id; postSwitchBranch declares /auth/switch-branch. Only API declarations are present here; upstream membership and event emission enforcement are unverified. Preserve occurrence branch before later switches.

Checkout prepare declarations carry cartId, branchId and userId. Assisted-order UI separately chooses company/customer/branch, then authenticated staff is forwarded as actor. Keep subject customer separate from staff actor; do not infer customer identity from staff login.

Developer portal accounts and commerce staff sessions are different from storefront customer accounts. Portal tokens use shared localStorage and logout clears/revokes; admin tokens use sessionStorage. No tracking identity reset/alias producer was found. Shared devices/tabs/accounts cannot establish person identity.

Canonical organizationId is nullable tenant scope; Josh copied company/branch UUIDs use another identity family. No authoritative server branch-to-tenant grant adapter is implemented for this foundation. Synthetic grant map is not production authorization.
Existing customer_metrics groups by user_id and includes payment_pending in active statuses. It cannot be reused as branch-level confirmed-order evidence.

approvalTransition.finding: No authoritative branch/customer account-application approval transition and timestamp were found in this repository. Credit review, KYC documents, staff admin access and environment-based developer key-mint approval are distinct scopes. Do not rename them account_application_approved.
approvalTransition.guidedPreviewApproval: Synthetic approvedAt trait only; real adapter and policy are blocked on authoritative transition proof.

consentAndSensitivePayloads.finding: AuthMe exposes pdpa_consent and privacy API declares marketing_consent. Neither proves an analytics processing basis or production GTM consent enforcement. New contract records granted/denied/unknown plus policy version; it grants nothing.
consentAndSensitivePayloads.retentionGap: Existing customer.deleted wipes copied customer data, customer_metrics and segment_members. A future branch projection needs an approved retention/deletion policy and propagation tests; no new persistence or migration is registered.
